info.name: Order & Payment Management API
info.description:
Extendable order and payment API (Laravel + JWT).

**Quick start:** run *Authentication → Register* (or *Login*), then *Orders → Create order*, *Orders → Confirm order*, and *Payments → Process payment*. The `token`, `orderId` and `paymentId` variables are filled in automatically by the test scripts.

All errors are JSON: `{ "message": "..." }`, plus an `errors` object for validation failures (422). Each request contains saved example responses for success and error cases.

item.name: Authentication
item.description: Register / log in to obtain a JWT. The token is stored automatically in the `token` collection variable and sent as `Authorization: Bearer {{token}}` on every other request.

request.description: Creates a user and returns a JWT (the user is logged in immediately).

response.name: Validation error

request.description: Exchanges credentials for a JWT. Rate limited to 10 requests per minute per IP.

response.name: Validation error

request.description: Returns a new token and invalidates the old one.

item.name: Orders
item.description: Orders belong to the authenticated user. Another user's order is reported as 404. Lifecycle: `pending` → `confirmed` → `cancelled` (a `pending` order may also be cancelled directly).

request.description: Creates a `pending` order. The total is calculated server-side as Σ(quantity × price). `status`, `total` and `user_id` in the body are ignored.

response.name: Validation error
Validation error (item fields)

request.description: Paginated list of your orders (newest first). Optional `status` filter (`pending`, `confirmed`, `cancelled`); `per_page` 1–100 (default 15).

response.name: Invalid status filter

request.description: Partial update (PUT behaves identically). All fields are optional. `items` replaces the whole item list, recalculates the total, and is only allowed while the order is `pending`. Cancelled orders cannot be modified.

response.name: Items on a confirmed order

request.description: Moves the order to `confirmed`, which is required before it can be paid. Allowed transitions: pending → confirmed | cancelled, confirmed → cancelled.

response.name: Unknown status

request.description: Cancels the order. An order with a successful payment cannot be cancelled (409).

response.name: Order already paid

request.description: Deletes an order and its items. Refused (409) when the order has any payment, whatever its status.

response.name: Order has payments

item.name: Payments
item.description: Payments are processed through a pluggable gateway chosen by `payment_method`. Only `confirmed` orders can be paid. Card data is used for the charge only and never stored.

request.description: Enabled payment methods and the extra fields each one requires.

Simulated card gateway. **201** when approved, **402** when the gateway declines (the failed payment is stored and returned). Test cards: `4242424242424242` approves, `4000000000000002` is declined, any expired card is declined.

response.name: Declined by the gateway
response.body:
{
  "data": {
    "id": 1,
    "order_id": 1,

    "status": "failed",
    "amount": 26,
    "currency": "USD",
    "transaction_id": null,
    "failure_reason": "The card was declined by the issuer.",
    "gateway_response": {
      "gateway": "credit_card",
      "card_last4": "0002",
      "amount": "26.00",
      "currency": "USD",
      "code": "card_declined"
    },
    "created_at": "2026-10-20T12:00:00+00:00",
    "updated_at": "2026-10-20T12:00:00+00:00"
  },

}

response.name: Order is not confirmed
Missing card fields
Unsupported payment method

exec: pm.test('Payment recorded (201 approved or 402 declined)', function () { pm.expect([201, 402]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

request.description: Simulated PayPal gateway. A payer email containing the word "decline" is rejected (402); anything else is approved.

response.name: Missing PayPal email

exec: pm.test('Payment recorded (201 approved or 402 declined)', function () { pm.expect([201, 402]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

request.description: Paginated list of all your payments. Optional filters: `status` (`pending`, `successful`, `failed`), `order_id`.
Paginated payments of one order. Optional `status` filter.
